gt_provenance.details: P1a GT is dataset-structural (fc unit index = ImageNet class index by construction, not model output). P1b GT is an external broden-style vocabulary top-2 cosine gap — a paired within-component comparison, not circular. No model-output-as-GT detected.

score_normalization.details: Only standard L2 normalization for cosine similarity. No metric divided by model's own max/mean/prediction statistics. Delta_pure and delta_sep are absolute or relative to independently-derived baselines.

result_existence.details: All C1 result files exist at claimed paths. Numbers match tracker: M6 k=16 top1_purity=0.898 delta_pure=0.897 p=1.89e-270; M7 k=16 layer4 delta_sep=0.02015 p=0.0. All tracker rows DONE.

dead_code.details: All metric functions are called. Minor documentation mismatch: m7 docstring says 'matched-control test' but implementation computes top-1 vs. top-2 best cosine gap on same vocabulary. Not dead code; a naming imprecision.

scope.details: Claim says 'every component c in a trained vision model' but only ResNet-50 tested (2000 sampled components). P3 cross-model (M12) SKIPPED by user directive 2026-07-14 and disclosed. Scope overstatement is documented but not corrected in claim header.

checks.eval_type: real_gt (P1a) + synthetic_proxy (P1b/P1c via external broden-style vocab)
